title: Zesty Bouncy Northern Thai Chicken Noodles
description: A kid-friendly Northern Thai dish featuring saffron and high-protein chicken, this recipe is perfect for a quick and easy dinner. The combination of grassy and bouncy textures makes it a fun meal for the whole family.
instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat and cook the chicken breast until browned and cooked through.
Add the saffron threads, fish sauce, and lime juice to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the coconut milk to the pan and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the cooked noodles to the pan and toss to combine with the sauce.
Stir in the chopped green onions and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Serve the noodles hot and enjoy.
